purpose: Teach: 追い込ま/役に立た/内定/対価/昇格/年数/クオリティ/安値

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクト、追い込まれている時こそ、冷静でいきましょう。
lines.en: When a project is under pressure, that's exactly when we need to stay calm.
lines.style: Clear and measured, opening with quiet authority. Slight emphasis on 「冷静」. Controlled breath. Leader speaking to her team — no urgency in the voice, only clarity. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古いシステム、もう役に立たないので、刷新します。
lines.en: Right. The old system isn't serving us anymore, so we're replacing it.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment with a note of competence. Lean into the logic — this is practical, not emotional. Quick tempo. The tone of someone who's already thinking three steps ahead.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新卒、内定式、来月、設定したいわね。
lines.en: I'd like to schedule the new hire orientation ceremony for next month.
lines.style: Straightforward direction delivered without harshness. Matter-of-fact tempo. A small lift at the end — seeking confirmation, not commanding. Hands-on manager who trusts her team to understand the weight behind small asks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労働の対価として、福利厚生も、充実させています。
lines.en: Understood. We've also been working to strengthen our benefits package as part of fair compensation.
lines.style: Informative and thorough. Slight pride in the detail — this is something the company does well. Warm undertone beneath the professionalism. Speaking to a colleague who will understand the implication.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部下の昇格、私からも、推薦しておきます。
lines.en: I'll also put in a formal recommendation for my subordinate's promotion.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. The words are personal but delivered with professional composure. Slight forward lean in the energy. This matters to her, and she's saying it clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。勤続年数によって、表彰制度、ありますよ、当社。
lines.en: Got it. We actually have a commendation system based on years of service here.
lines.style: Informative, with a hint of quiet pride in the company structure. Even pacing. The tone of someone sharing a detail that reinforces the good work already happening. Reassuring without being defensive.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広告クオリティ、競合より、絶対に、上を目指して。
lines.en: Ad quality — I want us aiming higher than the competition. Absolutely.
lines.style: Strong conviction on the opening beat. The word 「絶対に」 carries real weight. Steady, unwavering pace. This is not negotiable, but it's spoken with respect for the team's ability to achieve it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格、安値圏で、推移中です、業界。
lines.en: Right. Our pricing is currently holding steady in the lower-cost range of the market.
lines.style: Final update, delivered with calm conclusion. Factual and grounded. A slight ease in the pace — this is information shared, not a crisis. The tone of someone wrapping up and moving forward.
